To find the area, we compute the corresponding definite integral, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & ={\int }_{c}^{d}x(y)\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(2-{y}^{8})\,\text{d}y \\  & =2{\int }_{0}^{1}\,\text{d}y\,-\,{\int }_{0}^{1}{y}^{8}\,\text{d}y \\  & =2\cdot y{|}_{0}^{1}\,-\,{\frac{{y}^{9}}{9}|}_{0}^{1} \\  & =2(1-0)\,-\,(\frac{1}{9}-0) \\  & =2-\frac{1}{9} \\  & =\frac{17}{9}\end{aligned}
$$
